subject: Re: Migration & deployment mode selection for Skyline AI
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@skyline.ai>, Rina Mehta <rina@skyline.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps — deployment mode for Skyline AI

Thanks Sam and Rina — great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can line up the right deployment option (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem):

Summary of your needs
- Migration sources: currently using OpenAI API for public-facing features; separate legacy on-prem GPU cluster for internal/regulatory workloads.
- Key constraints: regulated PII workloads for some customers, strict data controls, and occasional air-gapped requirements.
- Traffic/scale: ~150M tokens/month today with peak concurrency ~200 qps across endpoints; expected 2x growth over 12 months.
- Latency SLO: P95 < 250ms for chat endpoints; some batch/async jobs OK at higher latency.
- Timeline: pilot in Q1 2028, production migration phased across 2–3 quarters.

Our initial recommendation
- Short term (pilot): Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) in your preferred cloud region — predictable throughput, shared VPC options, and ability to pin models and quantization profiles.
- For regulated customers: Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem package) — customer-controlled networking, KMS integration, and audit logs.
- Hosted API remains an option for non-sensitive traffic to reduce operational overhead and speed time-to-value.

Requested info (helps our SE assessment)
1) Monthly tokens and typical request size distribution (we received the spreadsheet you referenced — please send the traffic breakdown tab).
2) Which endpoints must remain air-gapped vs can be routed through hosted services.
3) Expected concurrency at regional level (us-east/us-west/eu).
4) Any current compliance audits or required attestations (SOC 2, ISO, etc.).

Attachments: redwood-migration-playbook.pdf, sow-template.docx, initial-traffic-estimates.xlsx

Next steps
- I can have our Solutions Engineering team do a migration feasibility call next week to map out steps for: API contract mapping (OpenAI -> Redwood), model compatibility/quantization guidance, and data residency options.
- Can you confirm availability for a 60-min SE call next Wed (11/10) or Thu (11/11) morning PT?

Thanks — looking forward to working together on the pilot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — that recap looks right. A few quick clarifications: 
- We'll attach the traffic breakdown tab to this thread (see attachment). Current split: ~70% public product traffic, ~30% internal/regulatory flows.
- Air-gapped requirement: only the payments & health-data pipeline needs to be fully air-gapped; other regulatory data needs VPC-level isolation and KMS.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II in place, currently doing ISO audit in Q2 2028.

Regarding deployment: early preference is Dedicated for the pilot to hit latency and predictability targets. If the pilot goes well, we expect to migrate the regulated workloads to a Private VPC or on-prem package for certain customers. Can Redwood support an on-prem air-gapped install for future phases?

I'm available Thu 11/11 9:30–11:30 PT for the SE deep dive.

Sam

Thanks Sam — helpful detail. Short answers: 
- Yes, we support on-prem and air-gapped installations as part of our Redwood Private offering; that’s typically treated as an enterprise deployment with an associated platform fee and professional services to handle the air-gap handoff.
- Dedicated for the pilot is a good plan — it gives predictable latency and lets us run performance tuning before any Private rollout.

Action plan and owners
- SE deep dive (Avery): Thu 11/11 10:00 PT — confirm calendar invite sent.
- I'll prepare an initial cost estimate and deployment recommendation (Marissa) by Mon 11/08.
- Please upload the full traffic workbook to the HubSpot deal (I've linked it below) or reply with the file.

Links
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2027-1198
- Migration playbook: https://app.redwood.com/docs/migration-playbook

If that plan looks good I'll open a draft SOW and include the air-gapped install option as a line item so you can review pricing.

Best,
Marissa
